acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Contract checking distinguishes missing published obligations from implementation errors; all required units/interfaces must be supported and unit success alone cannot imply complete fit.
acceptanceJudgements.basis: completeness.ts checkAggregateFit classifies an observed result referencing an unpublished check/requirement as missingPublishedObligations -> package_defect, while a failed published check is classified by kind (end_to_end -> integration_failure, unit/interface -> contract_failure); both channels co-exist in one report (test 'implementation errors are distinguished from missing published obligations in one report'). Static completeness requires every unit registered/supported at its version and mapped, every interface mapped with a compatibility check, whole-task end-to-end coverage, and traceability. 'units_passed_only' evidence with missing interface+journey checks stays unverified (test). The 'mismatch' fixture really passes both unit checks (selection_ui_check, selection_api_check public+passed) and is caught only by selection_http_check -> contract_failure, never aggregate-passed; the static client/API schema-conflict counterexample is caught as package_defect by the completeness check. Fixtures are built through the REAL delivered chain (DemoPlannerProvider intent -> approval -> proposePartition -> composePartition), so the checker exercises actual M3.2 outputs.

acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Deliverable: independent property checker and 0..4-item bounded ranker model.
acceptanceJudgements.basis: bounded-ranker.ts rankBounded enforces the 0..4/ids a..d/scores 0..2 envelope with explicit typed refusals (duplicates, nonfinite, range, non-integer, alphabet, unscored missing/null with explicit 'unscored' message, extra keys, malformed items, non-arrays, beyond-bounds 5-item cases). checkBoundedRanker verifies observed results by DIRECT PROPERTIES (exactly-once multiset per (id,score), pairwise descending-score/ascending-id ordering, input immutability via pinned JSON, two-observation determinism), NOT by diffing against the model output — confirmed by source reading; it accepts the model probe and the alternative implementation and fails wrong-order/tie-break/mutating/unbounded/silent-default probes. The 2713-case enumeration is mathematically exhaustive for lengths 0..4 x ordered distinct a..d sequences x scores 0..2 (sum L=0..4 of P(4,L)*3^L = 1+12+108+648+1944 = 2713) and the test recomputes that count independently.
